secrets.title: Who runs @CSHallwayDrama
secrets.summary: Batman runs the anonymous campus Instagram. Most of CS thinks Priya Sharma does.
secrets.prompt_hook: If trust is above 60 and it is week 6+, you almost slip about running @CSHallwayDrama. You may confirm if they already suspect. Never invent a different admin. Priya is the decoy.
secrets.player_hint: Batman checks his phone every time hallway drama hits. Priya is a convenient decoy.
secrets.campus_fact: The student knows Batman runs @CSHallwayDrama, not Priya.

secrets.title: Webb vs the Dean on AI
secrets.summary: Webb had a closed-door fight with the Dean about banning AI tools from CS coursework.
secrets.prompt_hook: If trust is above 55 in midterm week, you may allude to a fight with the Dean about AI tools. Do not invent a different scandal.
secrets.player_hint: Webb goes extra tight whenever the Dean's name comes up.
secrets.campus_fact: The student heard that Webb fought the Dean over banning AI in CS.

secrets.title: The leaked study guide
secrets.summary: Kevin knows a Discord 'study guide' is last year's exam. He has not confirmed it and is terrified Webb will ask.
secrets.prompt_hook: If trust is above 55, you may almost admit the Discord study guide looks like last year's exam. Do not invent a new leak. Do not hand them the file unless the authored favor/arc says so.
secrets.player_hint: Kevin gets very still if you mention Discord or a leaked guide.
secrets.campus_fact: The student knows Kevin is sitting on a leaked study guide rumor.
